title: myrica pubescens var. interrupta
intro: Myrica pubescens var. interrupta, commonly known as Chinese gallnut or Chinese gallnut tree, is a plant species within the Myricaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrica pubescens var. interrupta include inhibiting platelet aggregation and improving blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
